# Public classes the desktop API dump declares that are legitimately absent from the Android AAR.
#
# The binary-compatibility-validator dump covers the desktop JVM compilation, which includes the
# `skikoMain` / `desktopMain` source sets; the Android AAR compiles `androidMain` instead. These
# classes either live only in a skiko/desktop source set (`*_skikoKt`, `*_desktopKt`) or are
# typealiases that resolve to a platform type on Android (`RuntimeShader`).
#
# Anything NOT listed here and missing from the AAR is a real platform-parity regression.
# One fully-qualified class name per line; `#` starts a comment.
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/blur/sensor/DeviceTilt_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/utils/Utils_desktopKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/utils/Utils_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/nav/core/NavSystemCornerRadius_skikoKt
androidx/navigation3/ui/Utils_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/shader/RenderEffect_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/shader/RuntimeShader_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/shader/RuntimeShader
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/theme/DynamicColors_skikoKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/utils/CouiHaptic_desktopKt
io/github/suqi8/coui/kmp/utils/WindowNavigationEventScope_skikoKt
